patch_description: This version retains simulator-scored beam construction but restructures refinement into reusable exact-cost neighborhoods. It adds contiguous block relocation moves of length two and three after ordinary relocation, swap, and reversal moves stagnate. This lets related transactions move together across conflicting transactions, reaching lower-makespan orderings that cannot be accessed through single transaction moves alone. Several diverse beam schedules are refined, and small iterated perturbations provide additional locally optimized candidates without ever accepting an unscored schedule.
